_comment: Copyable risk.v1 skeleton. additionalProperties is false in the schema: remove every underscore-prefixed key before writing. Required: schema, producedBy, id, title, category, probability, impactEur, mitigation, owner, status.
title: <=120 chars, states the threat, not the topic
detection: The signal that shows this threat is being exercised now: log field, metric name, alert rule. Include the impactEur basis here.
mitigation: Imperative, names the file or component that changes. Proof: <test id or MISSING - path where it must live>
contingency: What to do if the mitigation fails in production.
_exposureRule: exposureEur = probability * impactEur, computed not typed
_probabilityRule: clamp((E * I) / 25, 0.01, 0.95) with E and I on 1-5 scales, each justified in one clause
